instruction.text: Jonah has experienced being a refugee. Read his story and answer the question.

atoms.text: <t-blue>7. Right to protection during war and while on the run</t-blue>

There is a war in Jonah’s homeland. In order to continue living in safety, his parents decide that they should escape together. After a long tiring journey, they reach a refugee camp in a safe country. Once there, Jonah and his family can get support and Jonah can even go back to school.

atoms.a: How is Jonah’s right to protection respected?
b: ++Jonah receives support, protection and the opportunity to go to school in the refugee camp.
Jonah was forced to stay in his homeland.
